svg.title: Disegno interno, disegno esterno
svg.desc: On the left, a head in profile drawn in charcoal; inside it, faint and dotted, the idea of a tree: the disegno interno. A dotted line, marked 'segno', leaves the head and arrives at a panel of rough plaster on the right, where a brush has drawn the same tree in red earth: the disegno esterno. Between them, Zuccari's pun: di-segn-o, segno di Dio in noi.
svg.text: the idea as it stands in the mind:
whole to one person, invisible to everyone else
the same idea brought out, where others
can see it, question it and build on it
